title: Asteroid City
content: Has anyone seen Asteroid City on Prime? I watched it 2 nights ago and the whole movie felt familiar to me- like I was watching one of my dreams unfold. Despite the mixed reviews the film received, I thoroughly enjoyed it and was completely captivated by Wes Anderson’s incredible cinematography and attention to detail. There were a few specific DREAM THEMES that stood out to me: 1. The movie takes place in a desert. Not just any desert, I swear this is THE DESERT I’ve dreamt about many times (and written about on this page). Furthermore, since the movie is supposed to be a play with fictional scenery and backdrops, it made everything feel even more dream-like. 2. In the first “Act”, there is a closed highway ramp that leads to nowhere. I know several people in this community, including myself, have seen this in our dreams. 3. The colors. Anderson’s attention to detail with the colors he chose.. I have no words. It was just beautiful to watch. What REALLY got me was the way he depicted times of day with colors in the sky/reflections on buildings & actors. I’ve never seen another film that perfectly emulates the true feeling of “dusk” and “dawn” the way this movie did. Again, it felt very dream-like with the dramatic combination of colors & lighting. 4. There’s a handful of scenes where a “bad guy” is being chased by a cop car. Although the high speed chase is a few feet from the actors (and there’s bullets spewing everywhere from them shooting at one another) nobody pays much mind to the action. Very reminiscent of dreams not making total sense. The “not making sense” thing happens a handful of times but this was the best example I could give. To my fellow MallWorld friends, I feel the movie is worth a watch. I’d be curious to know if anyone gets similar vibes.
